subtopics.name: Descriptive Statistics
subtopics.context: Hospital length of stay (2021 FRQ Q1)
subtopics.tech_specs: Scroll to view Min, Q1, Med, Q3, Max. Use Q1-1.5(IQR) for lower outlier bounds.

subtopics.name: Normal Curve Area
subtopics.tech_specs: Utilize -1E99 for negative infinity bounds and 1E99 for positive infinity.

subtopics.name: Inverse Normal
subtopics.tech_specs: Area must be input as a decimal. Select LEFT tail for standard percentiles.

subtopics.name: Linear Regression
subtopics.tech_specs: DiagnosticOn must be active via [CATALOG] to output r and r^2 coefficients.

subtopics.name: Residual Analysis
subtopics.tech_specs: RESID list is dynamically generated in [2nd] after a LinReg calculation.

units.name: Unit 3 & 4: Data Collection and Probability Models

subtopics.name: Random Assignment
subtopics.context: Dark vs White Chocolate (2022 FRQ Q5)
subtopics.tech_specs: Generates n integers. Requires manual filtering for repeated values if sampling without replacement.

subtopics.name: Binomial Probability
subtopics.tech_specs: Calculates exact probability. Use B:binomcdf for "at most" cumulative probabilities.

subtopics.name: Expected Value
subtopics.tech_specs: Input discrete outcomes in L1 and corresponding probabilities in L2. Output is mean(x).

units.name: Unit 6 & 7: Inferential Testing for Proportions and Means

subtopics.name: 1-Sample Prop Test
subtopics.context: Application usage at high school (2025 FRQ Q4)
subtopics.tech_specs: Requires null p0, integer successes x, and total n. Output yields z statistic and p-value.

subtopics.name: 2-Sample Prop Test
subtopics.tech_specs: Both x1 and x2 must be whole integers. Verify large counts condition for both samples.

subtopics.name: 1-Sample T-Interval
subtopics.context: House prices with pools (2010 FRQ Q6)
subtopics.tech_specs: Input raw data via Data or summary statistics (mean, sx, n) via Stats.

subtopics.name: 2-Sample T-Test
subtopics.tech_specs: Ensure Pooled is set to No. Calculates unpooled fractional degrees of freedom.

subtopics.name: Matched Pairs T-Test
subtopics.tech_specs: A matched pairs test is mechanically a 1-Sample T-Test conducted on the differences.

subtopics.name: Chi-Square GOF
subtopics.tech_specs: Observed in L1, Expected in L2. Must manually input df=(categories-1).

subtopics.name: Chi-Square Independence
subtopics.tech_specs: Calculator automatically generates expected counts matrix in [B].

subtopics.name: LinReg T-Test
subtopics.context: Tule Elk slope p-value (2023 FRQ Q5)
subtopics.tech_specs: Explanatory in L1, Response in L2. Set beta and rho alternative hypothesis parameters.

subtopics.name: Interpretation Templates
subtopics.context: Securing full credit on FRQs (All Years)
subtopics.tech_specs: Slope: For every 1 unit increase in x, y is predicted to increase by [slope]. r^2: [r^2]% of the variation in y is explained by the LSRL on x. S: The typical distance between observed y and predicted y is [s].

subtopics.name: Experimental Design
subtopics.tech_specs: Blocking: Grouping similar experimental units. Stratifying: Grouping similar population units for sampling. Blinding: Subject doesn't know treatment. Double Blind: Researcher also doesn't know.

subtopics.name: Probability Shortcuts
subtopics.tech_specs: P(at least 1) = 1 - P(none)^n. For Independence: P(A|B) must equal P(A). Mutually Exclusive: P(A and B) = 0.

subtopics.name: Confidence vs Level
subtopics.tech_specs: Interval: We are 95% confident the true [parameter] is between [low] and [high]. Level: If we took many samples, 95% of resulting intervals would capture the true [parameter].

subtopics.name: Identify vs Determine
subtopics.tech_specs: Identify: Just name it (e.g., 'Mean=12.5'). Determine: Arrive at answer through logic. Show the numbers you used, but no paragraph justification needed.

subtopics.name: Describe vs Construct
subtopics.tech_specs: Describe: Provide detail using SOCS + Context. Construct: Create a visual model (e.g., Boxplot) consistent with data and the 1.5*IQR whisker rule.

subtopics.name: Explain vs Justify
subtopics.tech_specs: Explain: Use 'Because' to show cause/effect. Justify: Defend a claim by linking specific data to a specific statistical rule.

subtopics.name: Compare vs Verify
subtopics.tech_specs: Compare: Mention both groups in one sentence using words like 'higher' or 'similar'. Verify: Confirm conditions via math (e.g., show np >= 10 calculation).
